title: GTA: Gated Toxicity Avoidance for LM Performance Preservation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the degradation in topic accuracy and observing algorithmic probability shifts (e.g., suppressing negative emotion words like 'anger' or 'bad' while amplifying positive ones) across sentiment and emotion datasets when applying Controllable Text Generation (CTG) toxicity avoidance methods.

Evaluating the reduction in topic consistency (accuracy) across various non-toxic news categories (e.g., tech, sport, entertainment, politics, business) to determine if detoxification methods disproportionately avoid or suppress specific subject matters due to training data bias.
